name: dcid-grammar-colon-prefixed-slot-ref-rejected
description: A slot binding's value ref carrying a dcid:-prefixed spelling is refused: the dcid grammar dcid-grammar-colon-prefixed-rejected already enforces on shape dcids now also runs on every slot ref (value, set, and exact alike).
notes: Before this vector, a dcid:-prefixed slot ref validated: the dcid grammar guard ran on shape members only. This closes that gap ahead of every reader, in the grammar itself rather than in a consumer.
